claim: Slot 14 is the SINGLE player shot: SHOTH = MOBJH+14. (the shot's horizontal motion-object cell). There is exactly one shot slot, so at most one shot exists at a time (AC-2).

corroboration.note: SHOTV =MOBJV+14. — the same slot 14 owns the shot's vertical cell; one slot => one shot.

claim: Slot 15 is the player gun: PLAYH = MOBJH+15. The gun and shot are adjacent motion-object slots (15 and 14).
MOVE horizontal LEFT-edge clamp: a candidate PLAYH >= 0xF4 (244) is pinned to 0xF4. (Left/right are reversed vs the motion-object video because the cabinet is ROT270.)

corroboration.note: LDA I,0F4 ;KEEP AT EDGE — the clamp value written when at the left edge.

claim: MOVE horizontal RIGHT-edge clamp: a candidate PLAYH < 0x0B (11) is pinned to 0x0B. Together with PS-3 the gun's horizontal range is [0x0B, 0xF4].

corroboration.note: LDA I,0B ;KEEP AT EDGE — the clamp value written when at the right edge.

claim: MOVE vertical BOTTOM-edge clamp (upright): a candidate PLAYV < 0x08 (8) is pinned to 0x08. This is the bottom of the player zone.

corroboration.note: 43$: LDA I,8 ;KEEP AT BOTTOM DGE (sic) — the clamp value written at the bottom edge.

claim: MOVE vertical TOP-edge clamp (upright, non-cocktail path 37$): a candidate PLAYV >= 0x31 is pinned to 0x30 (48). Together with PS-5 the gun's vertical range is [0x08, 0x30] — a ~40px band at the bottom of the screen. (The 0xF1/0xC8 paths are cocktail-only; CKC0=0 in the 1-player upright build, CENTI4.MAC:746.)

corroboration.note: LDA I,30 — clamp value for the upright top edge (0x30).

claim: TBLMT clamps the per-frame signed trackball delta to magnitude 8: |delta| kept if < 8 or >= 0xF8 (-8), otherwise limited to +8 / -8 (0xF8). So the raw trackball count fed to the gun each frame is in [-8, +8].

corroboration.note: LDA I,08 ;LIMIT RANGE TO 8 (and 2526 LDA I,0F8 ;LIMIT TO -8) — the +8 / -8 clamp values.

claim: TBLMT then SIGNED-DIVIDES the clamped delta by 2 (CMP I,80 sets carry = sign, ROR shifts it in), returning the integer pixel move (MSB, in [-4,+4]) and a half-pixel LSB (0 or 0x80) accumulated in PLAYHL/PLAYVL. Net max gun speed = 4 px/frame.

corroboration.note: CMP I,80 ;SIGNED DIVIDE BY 2 — the compare feeding the ROR that halves the clamped delta.

claim: The fire switch is read from port FIRE (0xC01); for player 1 it is bit D2, active-low (0 = pressed). The sim's device-agnostic input models this as a boolean (true = pressed); active-low is a hardware detail the shell abstracts.
Fire is detected by AND I,04 / BEQ: (FIRE & 0x04) == 0 means the switch is pressed. 0x04 is the D2 fire bit for player 1.

corroboration.note: BEQ 10$ ;SWITCH JUST PUSHED DOWN — taken when the fire bit is 0 (pressed).

claim: SINGLE-SHOT GATE (AC-2): the fire switch is only tested when the shot is AT REST on the gun, i.e. SHOTV == PLAYV+4 (LDA I,04 / ADC PLAYV / CMP SHOTV). If SHOTV != PLAYV+4 the shot is in flight and BNE 102$ skips the fire test entirely — so pressing fire while the shot lives is IGNORED, never queued.

corroboration.note: BNE 102$ ;SHOT IS GOING UP — in-flight shots branch past the fire test, so a live shot blocks re-firing.

claim: RE-ARM condition #1 (off top): when SHOTV >= 0xF3 the shot is off the top of the screen and is reset to the gun (BCS 108$ -> 20$ JSR RSHOT). The shot travels toward increasing V (the gun sits at low V, the top of the screen at high V).

corroboration.note: BCS 108$ ;IF OFF TOP OF SCREEN-RESET POSITION — the off-top re-arm branch.

claim: The shot's REST position is PLAYV + 4 (LDA I,04 / ADC PLAYV): the shot sits 4 px above the gun while attached, and RSHOT (CENTI4.MAC:1582) writes the same PLAYV+4 when re-arming. Detecting rest as SHOTV==PLAYV+4 is the basis of the single-shot gate (PS-11).

corroboration.note: ADC PLAYV ;SHOT MOVES UP 6 AND SHIP DOWN 3 MAX — PLAYV+4 is the shot's on-gun rest V.

claim: The shot advances +7 px per frame in V (LDA I,7 / EOR CKFE=0 / ADC SHOTV / STA SHOTV). This is the shot speed (AC-1). CKFE=0 in the 1-player upright build (CENTI4.MAC:750).

corroboration.note: STA SHOTV ;ADD 7 TO SHOT'S POSITION — the per-frame +7 advance.

claim: The shot-vs-obstacle collision is tested at V = (old SHOTV) + 1 (LDA I,01 / EOR CKFF=0 / ADC TEMP2, TEMP2 = old SHOTV), while the shot itself moves to old+7. Exactly ONE cell is tested per frame; because the +7 step is strictly less than the 8px cell height (PS-16), consecutive test points are <=7px apart and cannot skip a cell -> the ROM does NOT tunnel.

corroboration.note: ADC TEMP2 — TEMP2 holds the pre-advance SHOTV, so the OBSTAC probe is old SHOTV + 1.

claim: OBSTAC maps a motion-object V pixel to a grid ROW by dividing by 8 (LSR x3) and rounding to the nearest row (ADC I,0 adds the carry = bit 2 of V). So the playfield cell height is 8 px and vcell = (V + 4) >> 3.

corroboration.note: ADC I,0 ;ADD ONE IF HALF WAY TO NEXT ROW — round-to-nearest, so vcell = round(V/8).

claim: OBSTAC maps a motion-object H pixel to a grid COLUMN reversed about 0xF7 and quantised to 8 px (LDA I,0F7 / SBC H / AND I,0F8): hcol = (0xF7 - H) >> 3. Cell width is 8 px. For H in [0x0B,0xF4] this yields hcol in [0,29] = the 30 playfield columns.

corroboration.note: AND I,0F8 — clears the low 3 bits, i.e. floor to the 8px column.

claim: OBSTAC's base address is PLYFLD/4 (MSB byte 1) shifted left twice into 0x400, so the obstacle address is 0x400 + hcol*0x20 + vcell — the SAME (base 0x400, stride 0x20) addressing cp1-4 baked into playfield.ts. The shot collision therefore indexes the exact playfield grid, gated by isMushroom (PM-15/16) and resolved by damageMushroom (PM-17/18/19/20).

corroboration.note: STA OBST ;PLAYFIELD ADDRESS= — the completed address; the "800" in the adjacent comment is the cocktail/stale form, MSB 1<<2 = 0x400 in upright.

claim: The shot passes direction 0 to OBSTAC (LDY I,0 / GIVE NO DIRECTION), so no 8*direction offset is added to the horizontal: the collision column comes straight from SHOTH. The shot flies straight up its own column.
